text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- A Bahraini commerce ministry official is to visit Singapore, Malaysia and Scotland to improve trade relations.
- Bahrain commercial banks increased their purchases of treasury bonds from the Bahrain Monetary Agency in the first five months of 1997.
- A Bahraini delegation is to visit the Philippines to boost trade between the two countries.
- Around 1,200 Indians, staying in Bahrain unlawfully, have visited the Indian Embassy over the past five days to take advantage of a new amnesty for illegal aliens.
- Two Gulf nationals flying from Bahrain were arrested on arrival at London's Heathrow Airport for allegedly assaulting a passenger and crew member on a British Airways flight.
- Bahrain Telecommunications Company signed a one million dinar deal to install and operate the Intelligent Network in Bahrain.
